description: This file contains multiple internal class definitions for Orleans grains used in unit testing, including activation/deactivation lifecycle tests, error handling, and grain reference creation.

classes.name: SimpleActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that tests simple activation and deactivation lifecycle, asserting correct state transitions.

classes.name: TailCallActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that tests activation and deactivation with tail call continuations.

classes.name: LongRunningActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that performs long-running activation and deactivation, including thread pool and sleep operations.

classes.name: TaskActionActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that tests activation and deactivation with complex task continuations and scheduler assertions.

classes.name: BadActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: A grain designed to throw exceptions during activation and deactivation to test error handling.

classes.name: BadConstructorTestGrain
classes.description: A grain with a constructor that throws an exception, testing constructor failure handling.

classes.name: DeactivatingWhileActivatingTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that deactivates itself during activation to test deactivation during startup.

classes.name: CreateGrainReferenceTestGrain
classes.description: A grain that tests creating references to other grains and forwarding calls.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides for activation logic, including assertions and watcher notifications.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides for deactivation logic, including assertions and watcher notifications.

methods.name: DoSomething
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the grain, asserting state.

methods.name: ThrowSomething
methods.description: Method that throws an exception to test error handling.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the primary key of the grain, or throws if an error occurs.

methods.name: ForwardCall
methods.description: Forwards a call to another grain.
